items.abstract: <jats:p>We study the complexity of computing one or several terms (not necessarily consecutive) in a recurrence with polynomial coefficients. As applications, we improve the best currently known upper bounds for factoring integers deterministically and for computing the Cartier–Manin operator of hyperelliptic curves.</jats:p>
title: Linear Recurrences with Polynomial Coefficients and Application to Integer Factorization and Cartier–Manin Operator
